title: Absent default_lane_preset field is silently tolerated (falls back to preset index 0), not rejected at load
detail: Spec-3-2-lane-qos.md I/O matrix: "Catalog badness | preset with wrong arity / weight > MAX_WEIGHT / all-zero / missing default | rejected at load". The loader rejects an unresolvable default name but accepts a balance.json that omits the default_lane_preset field, silently binding the E5 fallback + every pipe's starting weights to lane_presets[0] row order. Current data file carries the field, so impact is latent.
recommended_fix: Treat an absent default_lane_preset as a named Catalog_Error (e.g. "default_lane_preset missing") instead of silently defaulting to index 0, and add a fail-fast test row.
